preimage: ascii(domain) || u32_be(entry_count) || for each entry in order: u32_be(len(key)) || key || u32_be(len(contentType)) || contentType || u64_be(size) || u32_be(32) || entry_digest
entry_digest: SHA256(salt || value); salt is 0, 16 or 32 bytes and is not in the preimage; size = len(value)
hash: SHA256(preimage) equals the proof's callerMetadata stage data_hash
note: Hex is lowercase. value_file is relative to this directory. Salts here are fixed patterns so the vectors are reproducible; real salts are random. Results: VALID (preimage vectors) or PASS-path VALID (check vectors), CONTENT_MISMATCH, MANIFEST_INVALID, CONTENT_UNRESOLVED (INCONCLUSIVE, exit 3), NOT_CHECKED, FAIL (stage required but absent). stage_data_hash null means the proof has no callerMetadata stage.

preimage_vectors.name: single_unsalted
preimage_vectors.comment: One unsalted text entry: entry_digest = SHA256(value).

preimage_vectors.name: salt_16
preimage_vectors.comment: The same value with a 16-byte salt: a different entry_digest, the same size.

preimage_vectors.name: salt_32
preimage_vectors.comment: The same value with a 32-byte salt.

preimage_vectors.name: multi_entry
preimage_vectors.comment: Three entries, unsalted, 16-byte and 32-byte salts, in the caller's order.

preimage_vectors.name: multi_entry_reordered
preimage_vectors.comment: multi_entry with the first two entries swapped: order is committed, so the hash differs.

preimage_vectors.name: empty_value
preimage_vectors.comment: A zero-byte value is allowed: size 0, entry_digest = SHA256(empty).

preimage_vectors.name: injectivity_key_value_a
preimage_vectors.comment: Injectivity pair with injectivity_key_value_b: naive key||value is "abc" for both.

preimage_vectors.name: injectivity_key_value_b
preimage_vectors.comment: Injectivity pair with injectivity_key_value_a.

preimage_vectors.name: injectivity_key_type_a
preimage_vectors.comment: Injectivity pair with injectivity_key_type_b: naive key||contentType is "abx/y" for both.

preimage_vectors.name: injectivity_key_type_b
preimage_vectors.comment: Injectivity pair with injectivity_key_type_a.

preimage_vectors.name: content_type_case
preimage_vectors.comment: contentType is compared byte for byte: same value as single_unsalted, different hash.

preimage_vectors.name: unicode_key_nfc
preimage_vectors.comment: Key in NFC (U+00E9). Paired with unicode_key_nfd: no normalisation, different hashes.

preimage_vectors.name: unicode_key_nfd
preimage_vectors.comment: Key in NFD (e + U+0301). Paired with unicode_key_nfc.

preimage_vectors.name: limits_at_maximum
preimage_vectors.comment: 16 entries, 64-byte keys, 127-byte contentTypes: every limit at its maximum, still valid.

preimage_vectors.name: large_streamed_value
preimage_vectors.comment: A 256 KiB value read from value_file; the verifier streams it with bounded memory.

preimage_vectors.name: no_entries
preimage_vectors.comment: Zero entries: the spec allows 1 to 16.

preimage_vectors.name: too_many_entries
preimage_vectors.comment: 17 entries.

preimage_vectors.name: empty_key
preimage_vectors.comment: A key must be 1 to 64 bytes.

preimage_vectors.name: key_65_bytes
preimage_vectors.comment: A 65-byte key.

preimage_vectors.name: empty_content_type
preimage_vectors.comment: A contentType must be 1 to 127 bytes.

preimage_vectors.name: content_type_128_bytes
preimage_vectors.comment: A 128-byte contentType.

preimage_vectors.name: content_type_not_media_type
preimage_vectors.comment: Not an RFC 6838 type/subtype.

preimage_vectors.name: content_type_with_parameters
preimage_vectors.comment: Parameters are not part of an RFC 6838 media type name; the contentType is type/subtype only.

preimage_vectors.name: salt_8_bytes
preimage_vectors.comment: A salt must be 0, 16 or 32 bytes.

preimage_vectors.name: duplicate_key
preimage_vectors.comment: Two entries with the same key.

check_vectors.name: all_content_matches
check_vectors.comment: Every entry presented as content, all match.

check_vectors.name: digest_only_mixed
check_vectors.comment: Content for one entry; the other two are digest-only, which is not unresolved.

check_vectors.name: manifest_only
check_vectors.comment: A manifest and no content: it recomputes the stage, every entry is digest-only.

check_vectors.name: large_streamed_content
check_vectors.comment: Content read from value_file and streamed.

check_vectors.name: manifest_uppercase_hex
check_vectors.comment: Hex in the manifest is case-insensitive.

check_vectors.name: relabelled_content_type
check_vectors.comment: The note relabelled text/plain -> text/html: the preimage no longer recomputes the stage.

check_vectors.name: salt_value_resplit_size_moved
check_vectors.comment: 16 salt bytes moved into the value, size updated to match: SHA256(salt||value) is unchanged, but the signed size is not, so the preimage differs.

check_vectors.name: salt_value_resplit_size_kept
check_vectors.comment: 16 salt bytes moved into the value with the signed size kept: the value is not size bytes long.

check_vectors.name: wrong_salt
check_vectors.comment: The right value with a different 32-byte salt: SHA256(salt||value) differs from entry_digest.

check_vectors.name: wrong_content
check_vectors.comment: Altered content for one entry.

check_vectors.name: size_changed_digest_only
check_vectors.comment: The manifest's size changed, no content: the preimage no longer recomputes the stage.

check_vectors.name: entries_reordered
check_vectors.comment: The manifest lists the entries in a different order.

check_vectors.name: entry_dropped
check_vectors.comment: The manifest leaves an entry out.

check_vectors.name: required_key_not_committed
check_vectors.comment: Content is required for a key the proof does not commit.

check_vectors.name: manifest_without_stage
check_vectors.comment: A manifest presented for a proof with no callerMetadata stage: it commits no content.

check_vectors.name: require_all_one_missing
check_vectors.comment: --require-content-all, content for two of three entries.

check_vectors.name: require_key_present
check_vectors.comment: --require-content note, note presented.

check_vectors.name: require_key_missing
check_vectors.comment: --require-content photo, photo not presented.

check_vectors.name: content_unreadable
check_vectors.comment: Content referenced for photo but it can't be read (a missing file, a failed fetch).

check_vectors.name: mismatch_beats_unresolved
check_vectors.comment: One wrong value and one unreadable: worst state wins, so FAIL.

check_vectors.name: required_content_no_manifest
check_vectors.comment: Content is required but no manifest was presented.

check_vectors.name: no_manifest_no_content
check_vectors.comment: The proof commits content, nothing was presented: not checked.

check_vectors.name: stage_absent
check_vectors.comment: No callerMetadata stage (never emitted, or removed together with a re-signed chain): asserts nothing.

check_vectors.name: stage_absent_required
check_vectors.comment: No callerMetadata stage and require_caller_metadata: FAIL.

check_vectors.name: stage_present_required
check_vectors.comment: require_caller_metadata with the stage present and nothing presented: not checked, not a FAIL.

check_vectors.name: manifest_version_2
check_vectors.comment: Only manifest v 1 is defined.

check_vectors.name: manifest_short_digest
check_vectors.comment: entry sha256 is not 32 bytes.

check_vectors.name: manifest_unknown_field
check_vectors.comment: An entry field the format does not define (here an inline value).

check_vectors.name: manifest_missing_salt
check_vectors.comment: salt is required; an unsalted entry carries an empty string.

check_vectors.name: manifest_duplicate_key
check_vectors.comment: Two entries with the same key.

check_vectors.name: manifest_salt_8_bytes
check_vectors.comment: An 8-byte salt.

check_vectors.name: content_for_unknown_key
check_vectors.comment: Content supplied for a key the manifest does not list.
